sources.full_hypotheses_used: Finite dimensional homogeneous polynomial modules for quantum GL_n over a field; q invertible. Specialization q=1 over algebraically closed positive characteristic is expressly admitted. Labels are partitions of fixed degree with at most target-rank parts; truncation N>=n. No n>=degree assumption for labelled truncation or2.4 equivalence. Symmetric-tensor multiplicity alpha is a nonnegative weight.
